title: Rest taps former CFO for new executive role
full_text:
Rest has appointed Kulwant Singh-Pangly as chief commercial officer in a newly created executive role as the profit-to-member superannuation fund advances the next stage of its long-term strategy.
Subject to regulatory requirements, Singh-Pangly will report to chief executive Vicki Doyle and join Rest’s executive leadership team. The appointment coincides with the next phase of the fund’s Super Simple for Life strategy, which is designed to support members from their first job through to retirement.
As chief commercial officer, Singh-Pangly will oversee strategy, finance, tax, valuations and investment operations, legal and company secretariat, public policy and advocacy, as well as strategic procurement and facilities.
Doyle said the appointment strengthened the fund’s leadership capability at an important point in its development.
“Kulwant is a purpose-led and experienced strategic leader with deep commercial, governance, transformation and superannuation experience. He knows Rest well, having previously made a significant impact as Chief Financial Officer, and we are thrilled to welcome him back.”
“Kulwant’s leadership will help us bring teams along on the journey, enable strong functional leadership and support high performance across the enterprise as we continue to scale, simplify and deliver for members,” Doyle added.
Singh-Pangly brings more than 25 years of senior commercial and financial leadership experience across superannuation, financial services, investment management, insurance, government enterprise and professional services.
His previous roles include chief financial officer at Rest, group chief financial officer at QSuper, and chief operating and financial officer and managing director business services at Queensland Treasury Corporation.
Commenting on his return, Singh-Pangly said the fund was well positioned for its next stage of growth.
“Rest has a clear purpose, strong momentum and an important role to play in helping millions of Australians achieve their best retirement. I am looking forward to working with Vicki, the executive leadership team and teams across Rest to help support strong outcomes for members.”
